mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in residential sales (RSAFS) above 0.3% signals strengthening housing demand, which drives consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS monthly growth exceeds 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.1%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces equity discount rates and stimulates risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.1% periods yield negative SPX 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly growth in employment (PAYEMS > 0.1%) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE < -0.1%) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.1% and UNRATE MoM change < -0.1%
failure_condition: The PAYEMS/UNRATE interaction condition occurs but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing expansion regimes (INDPRO > 100), rising industrial production signals robust corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 periods yield negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL > 0.2% MoM) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and reducing risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 0.2% MoM periods yield positive SPX 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 850,000 units (HOUST < 850) indicate a contracting housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 850 periods yield positive SPX 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% QoQ) and monthly residential sales growth (RSAFS > 0.3% MoM) signal a synchronized economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth > 0.5% and RSAFS MoM growth > 0.3%
failure_condition: The GDPC1/RSAFS interaction condition occurs but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy to stimulate the economy, lowering discount rates and boosting S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7.0% periods yield negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
